project_info.theme: Football match promoted as a romantic final bike ride metaphor
project_info.color_palette: Soft garden green, pastel floral tones, Viettel red, white, navy, multicolor ribbon

main_subject.detail: Two football stars ride bicycles side by side on a flower-lined garden path. The left rider resembles a Norway player in a red long-sleeve kit; the right rider resembles an England player in a white shirt and dark shorts with an England scarf over his shoulder. The headline says 'CÓ 2 ĐIỀU KHÔNG THỂ LỠ CHUYẾN XE CUỐI CÙNG VÀ TRẬN ANH GẶP NA UY TỐI NAY'. The bottom offer card reads 'SOẠN DK CUP7 GỬI 1331', '7.000đ / tuần', and 'MIỄN PHÍ XEM WORLDCUP TRÊN TV360'.
main_subject.style: Photoreal whimsical sports-ad narrative, lifestyle scene blended with football-match promo

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square advertising poster for a Viettel football weekly package using a romantic bike-ride metaphor. Centerpiece is a photoreal scene of two football stars riding bicycles side by side through a flower-lined garden path, one in a red Norway-style kit and the other in a white England-style top with an England scarf. Include the exact text 'CÓ 2 ĐIỀU KHÔNG THỂ LỠ CHUYẾN XE CUỐI CÙNG VÀ TRẬN ANH GẶP NA UY TỐI NAY', 'SOẠN DK CUP7 GỬI 1331', '7.000đ / tuần', and 'MIỄN PHÍ XEM WORLDCUP TRÊN TV360'. Background is a dreamy garden path with soft haze and flowers. Surrounding elements: Viettel telecom logo in the top right, multicolor ribbon sweeping through the scene, and a rounded offer card anchored at the bottom. Technical style: photoreal narrative advertising composite, soft dreamy daylight, romantic haze and gentle foliage backlight, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
